title: Distributed systems, for the interview
subtitle: Round 1 of 3: what do I already remember, before I open a single note?

data.question: What do I actually remember about distributed systems?
howto: Work in ink, in the colours on this page.
When the time is up, stop mid-sentence.
Photograph every page and send them back.

pages.title: What I remember, unprompted
pages.prompt: Write everything you can recall about consensus, replication and failure before you check a single note.

pages.title: The shape of the subject
pages.prompt: Put the topic in the centre and grow the map from what W1-P2 surfaced.

data.hint: Start from the terms you recalled, not the ones you wish you had.

pages.title: Explain it simply
pages.prompt: Explain replication to someone who has never heard of it, in plain words.
